I have built a modern **Full-Stack Business Landing Page** with built-in lead capture, live product simulation, interactive calculators, and an admin management dashboard.

---

### 🚀 What Has Been Built

#### 1. Interactive Landing Page Experience
* **High-Impact Hero Section** ([Hero.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Hero.tsx)): Compelling value proposition, live system status pill, dual CTAs, and an interactive agent mesh preview canvas.
* **Hands-on Live Product Sandbox** ([InteractiveDemo.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx)): Allows visitors to test simulated workflows in real-time with step-by-step telemetry, token metrics, and JSON payloads.
* **Interactive ROI & Savings Calculator** ([RoiCalculator.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/RoiCalculator.tsx)): Sliders for team size, manual hours, and compensation calculating annual reclaimed capital and ROI multiples.
* **Pricing Matrix** ([Pricing.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Pricing.tsx)): Monthly and annual toggle with a 20% discount badge, feature breakdown, and enterprise SLA highlights.
* **Bento Grid Feature Showcase** ([Features.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Features.tsx)): Highlighting core capabilities (Autonomous Orchestration, Unified Knowledge Sync, Sub-ms Routing, Enterprise Security).
* **Filterable Testimonials** ([Testimonials.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Testimonials.tsx)): Segmented customer proof by industry (SaaS, Fintech, E-Commerce, Enterprise).
* **Searchable FAQ Accordion** ([Faq.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Faq.tsx)): Quick search and categorized filters.
* **Dark / Light Theme Toggle** ([ThemeToggle.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx)): Theme switching with system preference persistence.

#### 2. Full-Stack Backend & Database Engine
* **Zero-Dependency SQLite Database** ([db.ts](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/lib/db.ts)): Uses Node's built-in `node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`), requiring zero external database drivers or native compilation.
* **Waitlist Lead Capture Modal** ([WaitlistModal.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/WaitlistModal.tsx)): Anti-spam validation, position-in-line calculation, and celebratory confetti upon signup.
* **Direct Sales & Contact Form** ([ContactSection.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/ContactSection.tsx)): Department routing and inquiry persistence.
* **Engineering Newsletter Subscription** ([Footer.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Footer.tsx)): Rapid email capture with duplicate prevention.
* **Live API Endpoints**:
  * `/api/waitlist` — Register & check queue positions
  * `/api/contact` — Receive customer inquiries
  * `/api/newsletter` — Subscribe emails
  * `/api/demo` — Run pipeline simulations
  * `/api/admin/leads`, `/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin/seed`, `/api/admin/export`

#### 3. Full-Stack Admin Hub (`/admin`)
* **Executive Dashboard** ([admin/page.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/admin/page.tsx)): Real-time metrics on waitlist signups, unread inquiries, and subscribers.
* **Lead Pipeline Manager**: Filter by name/company/email and update statuses (`new` → `contacted` → `qualified` → `converted`).
* **CSV Export**: One-click download of all waitlist entries and inquiries.
* **Demo Data Seeder**: Built-in button to populate sample enterprise leads for testing.

---

### 🎨 How to Customize for Your Business

You can customize the business name, tagline, copy, pricing plans, and FAQs directly in:
👉 **[site.ts](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/config/site.ts)**

### 💻 Running the App Locally

```bash
# Start development server on http://localhost:3000
npm run dev

# Or run optimized production build
npm run build && npm start
```

I have built the full-stack web application: the **NovaPulse Cloud Studio App** at `/dashboard`, integrated directly alongside the landing page and admin portal.

---

### 🚀 What Has Been Built

#### 1. Full-Stack Web App: Cloud Studio (`/dashboard`)
* **Interactive App Dashboard** ([dashboard/page.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx)):
  * **Workspace Overview**: Real-time KPI summary (Active Pipelines, Total Runs, Average Latency, and Token Consumption), quick test execution runner, and live activity stream.
  * **Workflow Studio**: Visual pipeline manager with pre-seeded enterprise workflows (*Autonomous Support Triage*, *Sales Lead Scoring*, *Financial Filing Synthesizer*, *Code Security Auditor*), status toggling (active/paused), and a modal to create custom multi-step agent chains.
  * **Live Execution Sandbox**: Run any pipeline with arbitrary JSON or prompt inputs, watch real-time node execution waterfalls, monitor token usage, and inspect synthesized JSON results.
  * **Telemetry & Pipeline Logs**: Audit trail of every execution run with latency timings, cost estimations, and an inspector modal to review exact input/output payloads.
  * **API Credentials Manager**: Generate live secret API keys (`np_live_...`) with instant copy-to-clipboard, prefix masking, and revocation controls.
  * **Model Routing Configuration**: Configure inference fallback rules between Gemini 2.0, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and GPT-4o.

#### 2. Backend Engine & Database
* **Database Models** ([db.ts](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/lib/db.ts)):
  * `workflows` — Chained autonomous agent definitions with JSON node configurations.
  * `pipeline_runs` — Telemetry, token counts, cost calculations, and run timestamps.
  * `api_keys` — Authentication keys for external SDK access.
* **REST API Endpoints**:
  * `GET`, `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` [`/api/app/workflows`](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/api/app/workflows/route.ts)
  * `POST` [`/api/app/run`](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/api/app/run/route.ts) — Multi-node execution engine
  * `GET` [`/api/app/runs`](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/api/app/runs/route.ts) — Execution history & telemetry
  * `GET`, `POST`, `DELETE` [`/api/app/apikeys`](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/api/app/apikeys/route.ts) — API key manager
  * `GET` [`/api/app/stats`](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/app/api/app/stats/route.ts) — App analytics

#### 3. Seamless Integration
* **Navigation & Hero CTAs** ([Navbar.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Navbar.tsx), [Hero.tsx](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/src/components/Hero.tsx)): Added direct **"Launch App"** and **"Launch Cloud Studio App"** action buttons so visitors can jump straight into the application from the landing page.
* **Complete Documentation** ([README.md](https://github.com/rosiemac812-dev/my-project/blob/main/README.md)): Updated setup guides, endpoint references, and architecture diagrams.

---

### 💻 Running the Application

```bash
# Start the Next.js server
npm run dev
```

* **Public Landing Page**: `http://localhost:3000`
* **Cloud Studio App**: `http://localhost:3000/dashboard`
* **Admin Lead Portal**: `http://localhost:3000/admin`
